verdict.rationale: The Admin API lets you manage API keys and workspaces programmatically, so you could issue a separate key per agent and perhaps isolate it by workspace. The evidence never describes permission scopes, restrictions, or least-privilege controls on those keys. MCP connector tool allowlists limit which tools an agent can use, but they are not credential scoping, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes or least-privilege roles, workspace-level isolation semantics for keys, key expiry/rotation controls for agent credentials, and independent corroboration.
